title: Volcanoes of New Zealand (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of New Zealand, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Maroa
rounds.fact: Maroa is a volcano listed in the source data. The data places it in New Zealand.

rounds.name: Ruapehu
